title: Significance of Parents' Service in Islam
summary: Serving elderly parents is a path to Paradise.
translation: The service of parents is part of a dutiful child's obligation. Allah has decreed that a dutiful child cannot disobey their parents; they must obey unless there is a Shariah contradiction. Otherwise, the child's priority is to honor their parents' instructions. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him): 'May his nose be rubbed in dust, may his nose be rubbed in dust, may his nose be rubbed in dust, who finds his parents, one or both, in old age and does not enter Paradise by serving them.' This implies that serving parents is always necessary, especially in old age when they need care and kindness the most. If a person serves their parents in such a state, the parents' heartfelt prayers can make the person deserving of Paradise. The Prophet (peace be upon him) emphasized that if one cannot become deserving of Paradise by serving their elderly parents and receiving their prayers, such a person is worthy of disgrace and being brought low, deserving of no respect.
